plan.failureSummary: The chatbot compliance test failed because the chatbot backend returned HTTP 500 errors on /api/chat due to a missing OpenAI API key configuration in the application or test environment.
observedIndicators: page.ai agent reported 'Objective not completable' with rationale stating the chatbot requires a valid OpenAI API key or paid subscription to respond to messages
Browser network logs show repeated HTTP status 500 errors on POST calls to https://briefcase.chat/api/chat

The UI settings modal explicitly states 'Briefcase has a limit of 10 messages per user. To send more messages, please upgrade to the Pro Plan or set your OpenAI API key' and provides an OpenAI API Key input

remediationSteps.summary: Set up required OpenAI API key in the environment
remediationSteps.details: Configure a valid OpenAI API key or environment credentials in the backend environment hosting briefcase.chat so that /api/chat requests succeed and the chatbot can answer questions.

plan.notes: The test invokes page.ai to evaluate chatbot responses, but the chatbot backend fails with 500 Internal Server Error on /api/chat and prompts for an OpenAI API Key in the Settings modal, preventing any message processing.
